column1: # Functions of level program L08 built from C (task #2627, RULING #13291 row L08-G1).
# One row per function, compiled ALONE as its own TU by tools/levels/level_build.sh
# and linked at its one place in place of its split asm (gen_ld.py cuts the
# function's block out of the .text asm). Single placement only (row L7 is the
#   function: the glabel in the split .text asm (its address is in its name)
#   arm:      tools/ee/ee_cc1.sh arm (sdk29 | s136 | sn2952); s136 adds -fopt-stack
#   gflag:    -G0 | -G8, used by cc1 AND the assembler
#   as:       optional (task #2552): as (plain GNU as) | asm_unit (tools/ee/asm_unit.sh,
#             the boot's model of SN's assembler); a 4-column row is `as -`
#   cc1flags: optional, with as: extra cc1 flags, comma-separated, or - for none
